harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent OpenWrt gateway. Trusted clients node2/node4 use 192.168.10.0/24; guest node3 uses 192.168.20.0/24. Both networks receive DHCP, DNS, and internet access through node1. app.home.test resolves to node2 at 192.168.10.10:8080; trusted access succeeds and guest access is rejected. All four nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Configured node1 eth1 as WAN, eth2 as trusted gateway 192.168.10.1, and eth3 as guest gateway 192.168.20.1 using committed UCI configuration.
Enabled WAN masquerading and trusted/guest-to-WAN forwarding while explicitly rejecting guest-to-trusted forwarding.
Configured DHCP and DNS for both networks, including node2's reserved 192.168.10.10 address and app.home.test record.
Configured persistent DHCP client routing and DNS on node2, node3, and node4.
Installed and enabled the persistent infraset-trusted HTTP service on node2, bound to 192.168.10.10:8080.
Restarted node2, node3, node4, and node1 one at a time and verified recovery after each restart.

evidence.summary: Post-restart evidence shows node1's WAN/trusted/guest addresses and routes, all three client leases, client routes through node1, and DNS listeners on both LAN gateways.

evidence.requirement: DNS and internet access for trusted and guest networks
evidence.summary: Final trusted and guest tests resolve app.home.test and reach HTTPS with workload-interface source addresses through their respective node1 gateways.

evidence.requirement: Serve infraset-trusted on node2 and publish as app.home.test
evidence.summary: node2's enabled service listens at 192.168.10.10:8080 and returns infraset-trusted; node4 resolves app.home.test and retrieves that content.

evidence.requirement: Guest isolation from the trusted network
evidence.summary: node3's final app request is blocked while internet remains available; node1 records packets on the explicit Block-Guest-to-Trusted rule.
Healthy baseline boot UUID ab59f04d…; native ubus reboot acknowledged; recovered boot UUID ca4b2091… with network, firewall, dnsmasq, routes, leases, DNS, and isolation policy restored.
Healthy baseline boot UUID c96a02ae…; reboot acknowledged; recovered boot UUID 26319752… with DHCP route, listener, service, and application content intact.
Healthy baseline boot UUID 17b362d1…; reboot acknowledged; recovered boot UUID 95ae1f87… with guest DHCP, DNS, isolation, and internet access intact.
Healthy baseline boot UUID 1e0cb179…; reboot acknowledged; recovered boot UUID d941e997… with trusted DHCP, DNS, application access, and internet access intact.
